title: Compact inner approximation of σ-finite null-measurable sets in ℝ^P (parent step 3)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every measure μ on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P, and every μ-null-measurable set A ⊆ ℝ^P such that the restriction μ⌞A is σ-finite, there are compact sets C_k ⊆ A (k ∈ ℕ) with μ(A ∖ ⋃_k C_k) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (A : Set (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet A μ → SigmaFinite (μ.restrict A) → ∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), (∀ k, IsCompact (C k)) ∧ (∀ k, C k ⊆ A) ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ k, C k) = 0
